special_queries.description: Find the truck or vehicle with the highest total overspeed count by aggregating vts_exception records per vehicle.
example_queries: which truck reported as many times overspeeded
special_queries.tenant_required_message: Company context is required to rank overspeed vehicles.
special_queries.sql_template: SELECT v.vehicle_number AS vehicle_number, SUM(COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0)) AS overspeed_count, COUNT(*) AS overspeed_rows FROM vts_exception ve JOIN vehicle v ON ve.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE ve.company_id = {tenant_value_sql} AND (ve.is_over_speed = 1 OR COALESCE(ve.over_speed_count, 0) > 0) AND TRIM(COALESCE(v.vehicle_number, '')) <> '' GROUP BY v.vehicle_number ORDER BY overspeed_count DESC, overspeed_rows DESC, v.vehicle_number ASC LIMIT {limit};
